Yɛn nnwuma Ahoɔden ne petroleum

Ahoɔden a ɛma adwuma kɔ anim.

Petroleum nneɛma ne petrochemicals a ɛka nneɛma-yɛfo ne gua a ehia wɔn bom.

Momma yɛmmɔ hokwan bi ho nkɔmmɔ
KAS Petroleum

KAS Petroleum

Ɛka Al Sheikh Investment Group ho

Efi 2003 no, KAS Petroleum aka nneɛma-yɛfo, wɔn a wɔde nneɛma ma ne adetɔfo bom wɔ GCC, Middle East ne Africa. Yɛn adwene si petroleum nneɛma aguadi ne nkitahodi a ɛma nnwuma kɔ anim so.

Efi petroleum ne gas a wɔnyɛɛ ho adwuma so kosi nneɛma a wɔasiesie so, yɛn adwumayɛfo ne ayɔnkofo yɛ adwuma de te wɔn ahiade ase na wɔma wonya nneɛma a ɛfata wɔn.

Nimdeɛ titiriw
wɔ dwumadi mu.

Nea adwuma yi de ba
kɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu.

Petroleum aguadi

Petroleum a wɔnyɛɛ ho adwuma, fuel oil, gas oil, pɛtro ne bitumen tɔn ne tɔ.

Gas nneɛma

LPG ne LNG aguadi ma adwuma ahiade wɔ yɛn gua ahorow so.

Petrochemicals

Sulfur, phosphate, urea ne nneɛma a ɛne wɔn di nsɛ ho abisade.

Mpɔtam nneɛma-ma nkitahodi

Yɛka adetɔfo ne nneɛma-yɛfo ne wɔn a wɔde nneɛma ma bom wɔ Middle East ne akyiri.

Hwɛ yɛn adwuma titiriw no yiye.
